n: The psalm begins with a look upward. Psalm 121 lifted eyes to the hills; here eyes go straight to God, enthroned in heaven.

f.w: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes

n: Like servants watching their master’s hand for a signal — for orders, provision, or help — God’s people keep watching him until he shows mercy.

f.g: Servants watched for hand signals from their masters.

f.w: until that he have mercy upon us

n: The plea is doubled for urgency: have mercy, have mercy! They are sick of being scorned.
They are fed up with the mockery of the comfortable and the arrogant — people at ease who look down on the faithful.
